question: Is terminal production-hook proof plus focused regression coverage sufficient to land this compaction fallback filter without live two-agent timing proof?
rationale: The code path is focused and source-backed, but it touches session-state and message-delivery replay boundaries where green unit tests cannot fully prove the original intermittent live timing behavior.

options.title: Accept Terminal Proof
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR exercises the production compaction hook and regression-tests replay removal plus safe-text preservation.

options.title: Require Live Timing Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live or Crabbox two-agent compaction recovery run showing one delivered reply and preserved safe source context.

options.title: Pause For Boundary Review
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want replay safety classified at a broader side-effect, transcript, or API boundary instead of this fallback-local filter.

recommendation.title: Accept Terminal Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR exercises the production compaction hook and regression-tests replay removal plus safe-text preservation.
